stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: The stubs say more than the count.

stations.title: Old count
stations.text: Two windows add at once and some adds vanish

captions: Saturday at Lanternquay: Diarmid's pier window sells beside Bridie's hut.
Both windows add to one count, and when they meet, one of the sales is lost.
You make the count, the ticket numbers and the takings safe for both windows.
Both windows sell at once, and every ticket and every fare is counted.
The evening count matches the stubs, and no two tickets share a number.
